description: Defines debugging classes and functions for OpenGL and EGL, including Debug classes, message handling, and label management.

classes.name: LabeledObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for objects with labels in GL and EGL contexts.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: Debug state management for OpenGL and EGL, including message logging, callback handling, and group management.

methods.name: setMaxLoggedMessages
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of logged messages.

methods.name: setOutputEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables output of debug messages.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function for debug messages.

methods.name: getUserParam
methods.description: Retrieves the user parameter for callback.

methods.name: insertMessage
methods.description: Inserts a debug message with specified source, type, id, severity, and message.

methods.name: setMessageControl
methods.description: Controls message filtering based on source, type, severity, and ids.

methods.name: getGroupStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth of the group stack.

methods.name: setCallback (egl::Debug)
methods.description: Sets EGL debug callback with attributes.

methods.name: isMessageTypeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL message type is enabled.
